purpose: Teach: 人体/巧妙/弔い/思春期/罪悪/文系/パトロール/搬入

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、本気で、絶対、人体、絶対、の構造、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, I was genuinely impressed by how thoroughly you handled the human body structure in your paper.
lines.style: Warm, measured recognition. Lean forward slightly. Clear eye contact. Pause briefly after her name—noticing her. Steady, professional but genuine.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。詐欺の、本気で、絶対、巧妙、絶対、な、絶対、手口、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to dig deep into the sophistication of fraudulent methods—I'm grateful you appreciated the research.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. A hint of relief underneath the thanks. Measured pace, sincere. The gratitude is real, not performed. Slight brightness when acknowledging the compliment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統、本気で、絶対、弔い、絶対、の儀礼、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you examined traditional mourning rituals—that was genuinely thoughtful work.
lines.style: Reflective, slower pace. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Warm but not effusive. As if she's noticing something she wants Sakura to know she sees.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、思春期、絶対、心理、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to understand adolescent psychology deeply through that lens—I really appreciate you noticing.
lines.style: Genuine relief in the voice. Not rushed. A quiet confidence here—she's being seen. Warmth without self-consciousness. Slight softening at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦争の、本気で、絶対、罪悪、絶対、感、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The guilt and moral weight you brought to the war section—that was mature and careful thinking.
lines.style: Present, engaged. Slightly more animated than before. Genuine interest in her ideas. Pause before 'mature'—she means it. Not praising performance, noticing depth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。大学、本気で、絶対、文系、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I focused on how university humanities education shaped that analysis—thank you for recognizing the work.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. A quiet confidence now. Speaking as someone who knows what they did well. Respectful but not deferential. The thank-you is proportional, not excessive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、パトロール、絶対、制度、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The community patrol systems you analyzed—you made it matter in a way that could have felt dry.
lines.style: Leaning in slightly. Sincere recognition. Slower tempo on the middle phrase. As if she's noticing Sakura's restraint and precision—not showy, but alive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。文化財の、本気で、絶対、搬入、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I examined the cultural artifact transport process very carefully—I'm really grateful you saw that depth in it.
lines.style: Calm, assured close. Not rushed. The gratitude here is the culmination—she's been heard across all of it. Slight warmth at the very end, a small exhale of relief.
